semantic_findings.topic: Complete authoritative source and output ownership
semantic_findings.detail: Kernels.kernel is an explicit alias of the frozen full base quotation. Program.program constructs entry, both nested source loops and final-state epilogue; Grid.runGrid executes each CTA against predecessor memory. Ownership/readback proves complete output coverage, disjoint CTA writes and last source visit for rounded corrected-row overlap. Kernel.whole_grid and real_grid expose arbitrary complete CTA permutations. Neither public endpoint takes a successful-run, whole-binding or computed-result premise.

Real.state depends only on logical key/weight/value/seed readers. It uses stride BT and rounded width ceil(BT/BC)*BC, clipped at T. Corrections are U_t-W_t@H_c; updates sum K_t outer corrected_c[t]. Optional seed determines H_0, history stores H_c, final receives H_NT, and returned corrected row uses c=floor(t/BT), its last visiting chunk. RealPhysical.history/corrected are independent of source execution and source summaries. Correct.chunk_delta_kernel_correct derives complete source execution, all three returned observations and exterior frame for arbitrary Real memory; no finite-word encoder or native-to-Real equality is assumed.

NativeReference.Inputs contains only key, weight, value and seed raw-word readers. NativeReference.seed/correction/contribution/accumulate/advance/historyState define the recurrence independently of source state, runGrid, states and historyValue/correctedValue. Physical BK/BC/BV padded lanes, zero-padding loads, FP32 casts, subtraction order and optional seed are retained, including effects for non-finite raw words. NativeBinding proves seed, correction, inner accumulation, outer-state induction and both output bindings. No source-result equality is a public hypothesis.

Both source dots explicitly forbid TF32. Pending dots lower to one ordered scalar FMA per physical reduction feature, with zero-seeded correction chains. For NC=1, Native.single_step_fusion and NativeReference.one_subblock_native structurally seed the update chain with live state. For NC>=2, multiple_subblocks_native keeps the final outer FP32 addition separate. The distinction is proved from the staged graph, without a split-versus-fused equality axiom. Independent TTGIR inspection confirms the live outer iter_arg as update-dot carry in all three saved single-subblock cases and a separate outer add in both saved multiple-subblock cases; live PTX contains scalar fma.rn.f32 and no mma.sync.

semantic_findings.topic: Raw bytes, original operands and Tensor observations

FPEquiv.Result proves history, corrected and optional final words at exact flattened Tensor addresses, all input bytes unchanged, and every exterior byte unchanged. Byte output is the inherited sequential publication of evaluated source words. This is not a new shared Torch.FP32.logicalValue theorem or a wrapper/allocator implementation theorem.

counterexample.title: Saturating INT32 accumulation loses admitted composed-input products
counterexample.trigger: matmul_quantize_int8 with contiguous FP32 fpa[1,262144] filled with -127, contiguous INT8 b[262144,1] filled with -128, FP32 b_scale[1]=2^-31, separate storage on one CUDA device and default fresh FP16 output; producer config0 and eligible GEMM config10.

counterexample.actual_under_recorded_instruction_model: The producer's admitted codes all lie in {-127,-126}. All products are positive.
